{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few rows of revenue to confirm it's string with commas
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
print('\nAre there commas in revenue? ', sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for the '999999.99' sentinel values
print('\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:', (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
